Definition: from G3722; to use the dawn, i.e. (by implication) to repair betimes:--come early in the morning.
BiblicalUsage: To come early in the morning appears once, in the last days of Jesus' teaching in the temple, when all the people came early in the morning to Him to hear Him.
TheologicalSignificance: What I hold is that the people who came early to hear Jesus knew something I forget: the best time to seek Him is before the day gets busy.
